title: Steam games “touched” when referenced or similar to design
author: Training-Ear-614
selftext: I started making a bunch of web based mini games. Some of the games I referenced design ideas used from other games. Diablo camera style, red nation gameplay style, resident evil inventory management style etc. I also have had steam offline for a bit. Interestingly enough, each game of these types (and more) have a “cloud out of sync” message on steam. Some of these games I don’t even have installed at all. I suspect that some of the agentic coding tools I’m using might be touching some of these files on my computer and somehow triggering a cloud sync issue. Even when I have no local files on my PC from some of these games. Anyone else see or know about this? The games are built on another machine but on the same network. So I find this very odd as the only connection is the ssh connection. I don’t have these coding tools on my PC at all.
